title: Chapter 414 News About The Grandmaster Blacksmith
content:
Chapter 414 News About The Grandmaster Blacksmith

The realm of the Sword God corresponds to the rank of the God of War at the level of a general, or the strongest king of the monsters.

Even in the entire Shenwu Empire, there are only a handful of existences like the Sword God.

Then, Wang Shuo took out the supplies from the treasure house.

Wang Shuo also gathered all the materials for the Shura suit, and Zhao Bangde and Zhu Dongheng also selected some epic equipment for their subordinates.

For the remaining equipment, Wang Shuo planned to equip his subordinates after they were upgraded to generals.

Although the materials were gathered, a master-level blacksmith was needed to forge them.

After asking Zhao Bangde and the others, they also said they were powerless.

After Wang Shuo returned to the territory, he had no choice but to ask Hadro again if there was any way.

There might be a master-level blacksmith in the Ice and Snow City, but Wang Shuo did not dare to stay there for a long time, nor did he dare to go there again.

Hadro was summoned.

"Wang Junshou, you really surprised me. You gathered the materials so quickly."

It was only half a month since the last time Hadro was summoned.

"It was just luck." Wang Shuo smiled and shook his head.

"As far as I know, it's not that easy to find a master-level blacksmith."

"If you want them to make a move, ordinary things can no longer impress them!"

"Think of a way?"

Wang Shuo hoped.

Hadro pondered for a while and said, "I can go to the Sky City of the Tianshuang Empire for you to meet Master Iron Hammer. This person likes to collect all kinds of rare minerals and is the easiest to talk to."

"But I don't know what County Magistrate Wang can provide to impress him?"

"Three ice phoenix feathers, do you think it will work?"

The most precious high-level material that Wang Shuo could take out was the ice phoenix feathers left by the Ice Phoenix Emperor before his nirvana.

"Then I'll try!"

After that, Wang Shuo handed Hadro a feather.

The feather exuded a biting cold, which was a good material for making ice-attribute weapons.

Hadro took out an exquisite box, put it away, and then left.

Hadro did not charge any fees for this trip.

He has seen Wang Shuo's great potential. If he can make friends with him, he may get unimaginable benefits in the future.

Therefore, he is very concerned about this matter.

Before leaving, he told Wang Shuo that he would get a reply within half a month.

Next, he can only wait for news.

...

At the same time, in Wu'an County, Dongfang Ling received news from his father Dongfang Ke through secret methods.

Alliance with Dahuai Domain?

Dongfang Ling looked tangled.

As a county lord, she has matured a lot after Fang Kai's death and understood the truth that she didn't understand before.

The girl's immaturity faded, and her eyes became more determined.

After hesitating for a while, she walked towards the teleportation array.

Wana City.

"Report to the lord, Dongfang Ling wants to see you."

Wang Shuo was discussing some matters in the territory with Duan Wenxi and others.

He was shocked. What is Dongfang Ling doing at this time?

"Please ask her in."

"Boss, then we will go down first." Duan Wenxi smiled.

Dongfang Ling walked into the hall.

Wang Shuo looked at Dongfang Ling in military uniform and said with a smile: "Long time no see!"

"Long time no see!"

The two looked at each other with clear eyes and smiled.

Let go, calm!

"I came to see you this time on the orders of my father, on behalf of Qingyang City to form an alliance with you."

Alliance?

Wang Shuo was surprised.

There are actually forces from outside the domain who want to form an alliance with him.

"I wonder what the conditions are?"

"No conditions. We just need to attack our common enemy, Tiexue City, together."

Dongfang Ling told Wang Shuo about the situation outside the domain in detail.

Wang Shuo looked serious, but he was surprised in his heart.

After all, he learned a lot of information that he had never known before.

"This matter is of great importance. I have to discuss it with the other two county governors."

"Then, I will wait for your good news."

The two were silent for a long time.
